verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents session recordings for debugging: rrweb web recordings that capture DOM changes and interactions, plus MP4 video, explicitly pitched as a way to "record and replay your browser sessions to debug failures." That covers the replay and video core of the story, but nothing shows an agent-level step-by-step action timeline or per-step debugging screenshots. The screenshot mentions found are scrape output formats, not run artifacts. missing for 10: step-by-step agent action timeline, per-step screenshots tied to a run, independent or hands-on corroboration of replay debugging.
